Topic.label: Synthesis and Practice: Mathematics in Architecture

Question:
The front view and left-side view of a building are both rectangles, and its top view is a circle. Which shape is the building most likely to have?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_291_q4_question_en.svg)
Solution: A circular top view and rectangular front and left-side views match a cylinder. A rectangular prism has a rectangular top view, a cone has a triangular front view, and a sphere has circular views from all three directions.

Original.prompt: 某建筑的主视图和左视图都是矩形，俯视图是圆，这座建筑的形状最可能是哪一种？
Original.explanation: 俯视图是圆，主、左视图是矩形，符合圆柱；长方体俯视图是矩形，圆锥的主视图是三角形，球的三视图都是圆。
